request: Restore the compact, theme-matched copy notification near the top; audit inconsistent item-window source badges and other related surfaces.
implemented: Item reference copies use the application clipboard action through a shared InheritedTheme scope, including captured dialog routes and nested hover/pinned overlays.
Opportunities retains explicit host callbacks and also recognizes the shared scope.

The existing top notification is placed in the root overlay so nested dialogs do not dim or cover it. Its original theme materials, wording, position, non-interactive semantics and 1350 ms lifetime remain.

Repeated copies replace one notification; disposal cancels and removes it. Active workspace/theme presentation remains live without restarting its lifetime. Clipboard failures retain the existing themed operation-error path.
